# waterlogged

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

## Overview

waterlogged is a data processing package for water data from continuous
water data loggers. It streamlines the process from raw data to clean data,
documents QAQC processing via R scripts, and does so without relying on
proprietary software.

The package was built for data from Onset HOBO barometric pressure/water
level (U20), dissolved oxygen (U26), conductivity (U24), and TidbiT loggers.

All core functions support both **file-based workflows** (read from / write
to disk) and **in-memory workflows** (pass data frames directly), making the
package compatible with interactive R scripts and Shiny applications alike.

## Installation

Install the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/daniella-lo/waterlogged):

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("dfo-pacific-science/waterlogged")
```

## Workflow

waterlogged was designed for hydrology monitoring across multiple streams
and wetlands over multiple years, with multiple loggers installed at each
site and station. File management and standardized QAQC are critical for
ensuring long-term data storage, accessibility, and integrity.

Central to this is a single metadata file listing each logger's serial
number, location, and timestamps of installation/retrieval
(*logger_manager.csv*). This metadata file is used by many of the package's
functions and should be maintained for each project.

Data processing is done by logger type from the previous field season (e.g.,
all water level loggers deployed in 2024). Processing annually ensures that
water quality reports can be produced for scientific analysis and management
in a timely manner.

Quality assurance is done by both automatic and manual processes. Automated
functions remove erroneous data and flag outliers and potential sources of
error (e.g., if water temperature or barometric pressure indicates a logger
may be out of water). Manual investigation of each station is then performed
using interactive time-series plots. All processing is recorded in QAQC log
files and as flag/edit columns in the data.

### Water Level (HOBO U20)

- **`bind_hobo_files()`** — read raw baro CSVs, link to metadata, combine
  by station → v0.1
- **`barometric_qaqc_all()`** — auto QAQC all baro stations (range, spikes,
  flatlines)
- **`bind_hobo_files()`** — read raw water level CSVs → v0.1
- **`add_nearest_baro()`** — attach nearest baro station by geographic
  proximity → v0.2
- **`convert_waterlevel_kPa_m()`** — convert pressure to water level in
  metres using baro compensation and a field reference → v0.3
- **`qc_waterlevel()`** — auto QAQC (negative temps, ice, step
  disturbances, dry sensor)
- **`plot_qaqc_timeseries()`** — multi-panel time-series plot for visual
  review
- Manual corrections as needed: **`adjust_logger_NA()`**,
  **`adjust_WL_offset()`**, **`adjust_waterlevel_spike()`**,
  **`wl_multipoint_correction()`**
- **`wl_set_datum()`** — (optional) convert stage to elevation using survey
  benchmarks
- **`write_clean_data()`** — export final dataset per station/year → v1.0

### Dissolved Oxygen (HOBO U26)

- **`bind_hobo_files()`** — read raw baro CSVs → v0.1
- **`barometric_qaqc_all()`** — auto QAQC all baro stations
- **`bind_hobo_files()`** — read raw DO CSVs → v0.1
- **`add_nearest_baro()`** — attach nearest baro station → v0.2
- **`convert_do_mgl_percsat()`** — compute percent saturation from mg/L,
  temperature, and pressure → v0.3
- **`qc_dissox()`** — auto QAQC (errors, negative DO, high outliers, ice,
  dry sensor)
- **`plot_qaqc_timeseries()`** — visual review
- **`wq_drift_correction()`** — correct sensor drift using field reference
  measurements
- Manual corrections as needed: **`adjust_logger_NA()`** (ice, dry,
  disturbance)
- **`write_clean_data()`** — export → v1.0

### Conductivity (HOBO U24)

No barometric data required.

- **`bind_hobo_files()`** — read raw conductivity CSVs → v0.1
- **`qc_conductivity()`** — auto QAQC (spikes, ice, temp range, dry
  sensor)
- **`plot_qaqc_timeseries()`** — visual review
- **`wq_drift_correction()`** — correct sensor drift using field reference
  measurements
- **`conductivity_temp_compensation()`** — convert EC to specific
  conductance (SPC) at 25 °C
- Manual corrections as needed: **`adjust_logger_NA()`** (ice, dry,
  disturbance)
- **`write_clean_data()`** — export → v1.0

### Shared Utilities

- **`resample_timestamps()`** — snap logger timestamps to a regular interval
- **`get_logger_data()`** — retrieve processed data by stage, station, and
  logger type
